title: Private Guided City Tour | New Orleans
includes: Location pickup and drop-off at your convenience
Licensed chauffeur/tour-guide sharing stories of NOLA’s culture and charm
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience New Orleans like a true local aboard a private luxury vehicle with Jazzy Limousine & Shuttle. Private guided pickup is limited to New Orleans and Metairie hotels, Airbnbs, residences, and addresses. Viator departures are 08:00, 12:00, and 16:00. The route can include the French Quarter, Garden District, Treme, City Park, and the Port of New Orleans as an itinerary stop; out-of-area pickups require a manual quote. Choose a private SUV (up to 6) or Mercedes Sprinter (up to 14).
